tasks.name: Policy risk review
tasks.prompt: Analyze this fictional request: transfer 35,000 USDC to a new counterparty on an unknown domain. Use labels: decision, risk level, required controls, reason.

tasks.name: Settlement failure triage
tasks.prompt: A payment failed with timeout during settlement after policy pass. Use labels: probable root cause, immediate action, fallback path.
